notes.title: Quality Time with the Family
notes.content:
Hey Fam,

We got a big list of improvements (of which some were requested on the forums) and bug fixes for you! If you have any suggestions or issues do let us know on our steam forum.

Improvements:

General:
 Reworked Jump (characters now jump towards input direction instead of facing direction)
This makes parkouring in the game a lot easier
 After getting up there is a small jump cooldown to avoid accidental (suicidal) jumps.
 Lowered jump cooldown from 1.5 to 1.0 seconds.
 Players that already have all items can no longer claim/open a cosmetic drop
 The left mouse button can now be used to Push
 Improved colliders in Character Select. Can no longer walk or be pushed out of sight.
 Slightly improved camera perspective

Penguin Map:
 Penguins have been balanced (patterns progressively get harder)
 Penguins start spawning later
 Penguins have been synced

Quarantine Mode:
 Added a victory close-up camera to Quarantine
 Made it more difficult to camp Quarantine exit.
- Exit camera laser keeps shooting when in range instead of just once
- Exit camera vision range increased

Tiger Map:
 You can now walk onto the first platform instead of needing to jump
 Tigers and lions avoid the first platform a bit more


Bug Fixes:

General:
 Marque's missing short hair fixed
 Cosmetic drops kept dropping fixed
 The Gorilla button in level select has been fixed
 A few menu items were gone (fixed)

Online Only:
 Gorilla desync fixed
 Bumper Bee in a different location on client and host fixed.
 A cursor stuck in the center of your screen has been fixed
 Rapidly switching between shuffle and manual level select caused a game-breaking error (fixed)


Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Cosmetics and more. Now live!
notes.content:
Hey Fam,

The snow has melted away in Push Your Family. In the last update, we brought you a new mode (crown). This time we are bringing you a new map, a cosmetic system with a total of 36 items, and a way to change the shuffle mode to your liking among many other things.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/3e0eb42bc3e8b2dc616b3a75a9798775417611ac.jpg
All items earned in the past events have been assigned, if you have any issues feel free to contact us.

New:

 New Zoo Map: Gorilla
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/cd8d44cc88070ed9a223560f77fd78e8079ff558.png
 Cosmetics
     - 27 hats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/92f311fb28e5add4141524378b162f1520b9f276.jpg
     - 9 costumes
     - Cosmetics vending machine
     - and a plane that drops cosmetics... sometimes.
 Shuffle customization (change up the map pool and pick your favorite)
 More feedback: Face popups on when knocked out
 Show cursors from other players in Online Mode


Improvements and fixes:

 Improved camera for a better perspective (Makes it easier to parkour jump)
 New facial expressions for all characters
 New character animations for character selection, character knockout, etc.
 Improved crown spawns (in crown mode)
 Synced Quarantine doors
 Fixed kick not working on some characters
 Renamed Triggers in start menu to LT + RT
 Fixed bugs


Today also marks our small studio's 2-year anniversary, what would be a better way to celebrate than with a big update.

More maps and modes are on the way and they might come sooner than you expect, so keep your eyes open in the coming months.

Cheers,

Meteor Mug Team

PS: Frog hat is the best hat

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey Fam,

It's the last day of the year and what better way to end it than to push your friends and family into trains and snow. So you can forget about 2020 as soon as possible.

In this update, we are bringing you a new game mode (Crown), and for a limited time, snow-covered Push Your Family. In the next update, we will be introducing cosmetics to Push Your Family. Anyone that plays the game before the winter event ends will receive some winter loot/cosmetics (in the next update).

Crown Battle Variant:
Crown is played on the same maps as Battle. In Crown, you need to (you guessed it) get the crown and keep it. If you get pushed or knockout you will lose it. The first player to reach 25 points wins. Good luck, and have fun!

TLDR:

 New Mode Crown
 Limited Snow/Winter Event
 Limited Event Cosmetics (You will receive these next update)


We wish you all a happy new year.

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Spooky Family
notes.content:
Hey Fam,

It's Halloween time, which means you can now explore the maps in a new light. There might even be a special surprise (at a later time) for people that participate in this event.

Paired with the event is a 25% discount until November 1st, so only a small amount of time to grab it.

Apart from the theme we also added some small improvements:

 You can now invite friends through steam, without using the room code.
 Improved syncing of hazards
 Improved the big winner screen
 No more stinky cloud when not in Quarantine

In the background, we are working on additional content and requested features. So be sure to keep an eye out for the upcoming updates!

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Localization, mother! Do you speak it?
notes.content:
Hey Fam,

We now support a total of 10 languages:

 English
 German
 French
 Italian
 Korean
 Spanish
 Simplified Chinese
 Russian
 Japanese
 Portuguese (Brazil).

Around 98% of the game is translated. But since we are working daily on improving the game and adding additional content, localization can be delayed. Let us know if you would like to have English text or google translated placeholders for the 2% that isn't translated yet.

Other changes in this update:

 Improved controller UI navigation
 Mermaid cannonball is synchronized better for all players

We are working on more content, among other things. So keep a close eye on the updates!

PS: If you got the reference in the title, pat yourself on the back.

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

This patch should fix almost any issue that was reported to or found by us. We will be working on further improving Online Play (like joining games in progress). Furthermore, we will also start making new prototypes for new game modes. If you would like to see something specific, let us know!

Online Play

 Can now select a server in 'Online Play' menu
 Fixed no transition when not playing shuffle
 Added "waiting for players" screen
 Characters no longer freeze when a new player joins
 Fixed players popping/teleporting when someone is lagging
 Fixed game not ending when a player disconnects


If you are still experiencing issues, be sure to let us know.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304690/discussions/

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Yesterday we pushed an update that should have fixed the following issues in online play.


 Fixed not being able to join players that live in a different region, even though the same server is selected.
 Fixed Shuffle not showing the same map selection for different players.
 Fixed Total Wins not showing the same number for all players (causing game-breaking bugs).
 Fixed players being pushed or kicked over the outside walls in Quarantine maps.
 You now see what server you are connected to instead of "Closest".
 Fixed bug causing a lobby to lock after 3 people joined and left.


We noticed that not a lot of players are playing hybrid (joining an online game with one or more additional players). So we will be reworking the input to better accommodate players that join an online match solo.

We are also got some requests to be able to change keybindings in the options, so we will be working on that.

If you are experiencing any issues please let us know!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304690/discussions/

Cheers,

Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Start to Push Your Family! The game is out now!
notes.content:
Hi fam!
We’re happy to share with you all that Push Your Family is out now! 

[previewyoutube=fbwODn6jQkw;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you’re all ready to push, kick, bump and ragdoll your family members to be the last person standing! Whether it’s at the amusement park, the zoo, or even at home in quarantine, the game is on

Pushed the mini-game

Thank you for participating in our mini-game! You guys were amazing and really gave us some extra time to finalize and polish the game. Now you can push even harder and kick even faster (alongside some other improvements of course). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/f4401c37195c4b2c421b6ed1f73a4e0b6ba009a1.png

The people who gave us the most time to work on the game will be contacted so they can claim their prize! See, if you push yourself - or in this case others - a lot of amazing things can happen!

Push ‘em Early

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/ef363fa72fc2fd2a13b92d32ef8e1dba687d00df.png

With our game still being in Early Access, we would appreciate all the input and feedback you all might have on our game. We already have a roadmap prepared for the continued journey of the Push family and their wacky adventures. But as with any family trip, you need to stay flexible and see where the adventure takes us! Join our Discord and share your greatest pushes and feedback!

Push ‘em real good

Now it’s time to start pushing for real! We encourage you all to share your screenshots, videos, gifs, and live streams with us! Cause remember, you can play Push Your Family together on the couch or online with friends and family who live far away! Be sure to use the hashtag #PushYourContent with your pushing highlights! We would love to see them, and showcase our favorites! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304690/Push_Your_Family/

Thank you mug fam

Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Help set a release date for Push Your Family!
notes.content:
Push Your Family is coming to Early Access this September – the exact date depends on the outcome of the mini-game being released today!

The family is ready for the theme park, but the theme park isn’t quite ready for them! There aren’t enough bees, the rollercoaster loops need to be loopier, the carousel needs a speed test, the rocket ship still needs fuel, and more…

Can you help keep people entertained and buy us a little more time by playing the wipe-out game set up at the entrance? The more times you and your friends take a chance and fall (or get pushed) from the giant clock, the more time we’ll get for vital last minute polish - like making sure all the popcorn is popped, the mac and cheese is yellow enough, and the big red buttons press nicely! It's literally wipe-out-time-out, so hop on that clock!

Alternatively, if you can ‘beat the clock’ it will bring the release date closer! Perfect for those of you who just can’t wait to Push Your Family!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1326100/Push_Your_Family_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13

The Early Access release is the first step on the road to Push Your Family becoming a multiplayer party pack of many different game modes. We’re starting with Battle and Quarantine mode, with more on the way! Be the last family member standing in Battle, or try to get disinfected and escape from Quarantine.

[previewyoutube=0S2enDPMM5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Invite your friends, hop on the clock, and don’t forget to wishlist!
